title: Kimball's 18th Street tower rebuilt to its photographs
items: 1801 Prairie's round tower is now a slim shaft under a wider corbelled top stage with small square windows, as the c. 1895 Taylor print and the 1965 HABS photograph both show it. It used to be one tall, narrow cylinder.

Its broad slate cone now springs and peaks about 2 m lower than before, under a heavy stone cornice and a tall finial. The blank stretch of shaft between the main windows and the corbels now matches the pictures, and so does the small corner turret's tall finial.
